JAX_correspondence: Defaults/names/hard bounds/validation/derived/init have explicit implementations; pack/unpack represented by fixed Native ordering dictionaries, no separate bodies. Root explicitly includes both packing routines in supported8.
global_state_contract: All module data are PARAMETER constants/catalogs/bounds and existing nu_vertical_res_dep type, no mutable module instance. Existing ClubbDriver owns parameter matrices, derived nu object, lmin and mixture limit. No new class/global cache/state argument.
catalog_contract: 105 parameter names in exact Native32-character order and 2x105 bounds, preserving source literal kinds/tiny/huge/epsilon. Existing parameter_indices.hpp already provides zero-based positions; Native physical grid metadata remains one-based.
IO_contract_approved_by_root: C++ actual default setter -> existing descriptor/namelist owner extension for call-local initialized105arrays using Native clubb_params_nl -> C++ actual private pack. Preserve required iunit; established I/O-only NEWUNIT adaptation recorded at exact bridge. No Native private pack/unpack calls.
packing_contract: pack:ngrdcol+105 rank1 input arrays -> column-first matrix; unpack:one rank1 parameter vector ->105scalar outputs, no ngrdcol argument. Native unpack has no repository CALL site, but remains private supported source scope.
derived_contract: Allocate all7 nu fields only when nu1 absent; lmin writes then fatal ANY before mixture/spacing/nu math. Preserve prescribed/type3/type1/type2 branch order, native one-based physical bounds, all7 nu mappings. Invalid grid_type with no prescribed spacing leaves Native avg_deltaz undefined; do not fabricate fallback.
draft_shape_plan: Procedure/include/catalog merge fragments preserve generated nu type. Header templates can retain generic View memory/execution policy; initialization uses call-local HostSpace Kokkos storage at Native I/O boundary. Component/View aliases only inside kernels; ordered host diagnostic boundary reuses array owner.
wrapper_ownership: This group stages exact existing calc_derived_params_api wrappers for actual driver calls; root owns other API wrappers.
